arguments.command:
export DRIVE_SESSION_TAG=nothingness_seek_linux; export DRIVE_TARGET=linux; export DRIVE_RUN_LOG=/tmp/flutter_run_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}.log; export DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO=/tmp/flutter_input_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}; export DRIVE_DESKTOP_HOME=/tmp/nothingness_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}; .claude/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py call ext.nothingness.dragByKey key=hero-seek-gesture dx=400 dy=0 steps=20 kind=touch >/tmp/dragres.json && cat /tmp/dragres.json && .claude/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py call ext.nothingness.getPlaybackState > /tmp/pstate2.json && python3 - <<'PY'
import json
import sys
with open('/tmp/pstate2.json') as f: data=json.load(f)
print('after: isPlaying',data.get('isPlaying'))
si=data.get('songInfo')
print('after: songInfo', 'present' if si else None)
if si: print('after: position',si.get('position'),'duration',si.get('duration'))
PY
